task: Independently review the AI reference labels, then perform Laya calibration and evaluation. Label review is distinct from Laya measurement.
dataset_status: AI-authored reference set; ready for independent label review and exploratory evaluation; not the original preregistered human-authored corpus
author: OpenAI Codex (AI; this conversation)
required_reporting: State AI authorship and all protocol departures before any model metric.
Separate synthetic positives from frozen candidate negative controls; source/style is confounded with label pattern.
State that this corpus does not satisfy the original source mix. Do not claim the original M1 gate passed from this dataset.
Treat hypotheses in fixture: nodes as fictional test situations, not real Vinc measurements.
Record SHA256 of the exact gold, split, calibration files, checkpoint and question wording.
Do not silently overwrite or revise labels after looking at Laya predictions. Corrections need a new dataset version and frozen split.

label_review.instructions: Apply questions.json criteria to visible A/B/context only. Produce an independent three-label judgment before consulting reference-labels.jsonl; include disagreements and unsure labels. The model under test must never receive source/gen/note/rationale/labels.
label_review.scope_rule: Check subject, scope, time and verdict before calling a contradiction or equivalence.
label_review.semantic_reversal: The 44 semantic_reversal rows are contradicts=1; the method prose groups them under hard negatives ambiguously. Explicit negation is a separate tag.

split.method: Keep all three pairs in each authored scenario on one side; stratify scenarios by language and frozen candidates by source/language.
split.departure: Original PR #675 splits individual pairs; that would split 44 of these 60 authored families across calib/eval.
split.remaining_limitation: 33 frozen statement texts occur on both sides; this is not globally node-disjoint.

sequence: Freeze all temperatures and abstention thresholds
Report every eligible prediction, every abstention, every truncation and all protocol deviations.

harness_review_findings_before_formal_re: At the pinned commit, report.py calls coverage_at_error on evaluation predictions rather than using the calibrated abstain_below values. A post-hoc threshold on evaluation labels is not the preregistered frozen-threshold measurement.

At the pinned commit, report.py drops high-asymmetry pairs before computing the reported coverage denominator. Report coverage against all eligible evaluation pairs with asymmetry refusals counted as abstentions.
run_gold calls system_one and records_from_labeled separately per state; median_s includes both. Its timing is not a measured batch_size=16 throughput.
Check actual tokenizer usage during inference: only the 400-character input limit was checked here.
